name: Takeshita Yuriko
source:
Married woman having an affair with a younger boy. She is in her late 20s.

Personality wise, she is calm. A little natural.

She is infatuated with a younger boy and apparently, she is on a secret trip to a traveler's  lodge.

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp7/game06.html]official site[/url]]
